liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Good Lovin'** (2 reviews): Reviewer recommends starting here, calling it Pigpen's tune with everything firing; Short but driving from beginning to end [6][8]
- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Reviewer praises it as coming from a period of remarkable development for the piece; Reviewer ranks it among the top ten, suggesting the band was eager after not playing it since January 4 [7][13]
- **Dire Wolf** (1 review): Sounds polished like a studio take rather than a live performance [12]
- **Mason's Children** (1 review): Strong version; reviewer wonders why it was left off Workingman's Dead [7]
- **High Time** (1 review): Band sings with great feeling on this one [8]

## The recordings

- **gd70-01-17.sbd.cotsman.19283.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 14 songs; 107 min; rated 3.84/5 by 19 [1]. Said about its sound: Soundboard probably better than what the audience heard; Jerry's guitar sits well forward in the mix; An electrical buzz begins during Mason's Children and recurs through the rest of the set; There is a reel flip during High Time at 4:40 [1][5]
- **gd70-01-17.sbd.clugston.2220.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 14 songs; 112 min; rated 3.13/5 by 15 [2]. Said about its sound: Some distortion in places, but still very listenable; Good recording but only middling sound quality [3][11]

## Around the show

- Band played at Oregon State in Corvallis, roughly 30 miles from Kesey's hometown; room acts as a natural bass amplifier [5]
- Reviewer rates this the best of several versions from earlier that year they have heard [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-01-17.sbd.cotsman.19283.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by JCotsman; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Dire Wolf cuts in after several verses, and the first minute of China Cat Sunflower is missing [1]
- **gd70-01-17.sbd.clugston.2220.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Scott Clugston; source: Soundboard [2]
